candidates.titulo: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
candidates.resumen: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

candidates.titulo: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
candidates.resumen: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

candidates.titulo: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
candidates.resumen: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.
